reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Scaling up Malaria Control for Impact - Cameroon (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Cameroon, Malaria, Ministry of Public Health of the Republic of Cameroon (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria morbidity by 75% compared to the 2000 rate by the year 2018. To reduce malaria mortality by 75% compared to the 2000 rate by the year 2018. The objectives of this program are: Ensure that at least 80% of the population sleeps under a long lasting insecticide treated bed net (LLIN) by the year 2018. Protect at least 80% of children aged 03 to 59 months in areas targeted for seasonal malaria chemoprophylaxis (SMC) by the year 2018. Protect at least 80% of pregnant women with Intermittent Preventive Treatment according to national guidelines by the year 2018. Test at least 80% of suspected malaria cases in health facilities and communities using microscopy or rapid diagnostic tests (RDT), by the year 2018. Treat 100% of confirmed malaria cases according to the national guidelines in health facilities and communities by the year 2018
